blocks.text: Light ki polarization ki bunyadi aqsam yeh hain.
Jab electric field vector ek hi satah mein jhoole to light linearly polarized kehlati hai (Fig. 8.4a). Misal polarizing filter, jaise dhoop ke chashmon (sunglasses), se guzarti light hai.

blocks.alt: x aur x' (pari), y aur y' (khari) aur z aur z' (gehrai mein) axes O par milti hain. Ek sine lehar x ke saath x-y satah mein chalti hai; axis se oopar ke aadhe hisse magenta khari lakeeron se aur neeche ke cyan lakeeron se bhare hain. Label: Space (3D).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4 (a): Light ki linear polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.4 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khari lakeerein har nuqte par E ki lambai aur simt dikhati hain. Sab lakeerein ek hi (x-y) satah mein hain aur sirf oopar ya neeche hain: E kabhi z ki taraf nahi murta. Yahi linear (plane) polarization hai.

Jab electric field daire mein ghoome, ya to ghari ki suiyon ki simt (right-handed) ya ulti simt (left-handed), to light circularly polarized kehlati hai (Fig. 8.4b). Kitab ki di hui misal CD (Compact Disc) ya DVD (Digital Versatile Disc) se mun'akis (reflect) hone wali light hai.

blocks.alt: Pari axis teer ke gird gehrai mein bana shaffaf cylinder, baen sire par khari axis. Axis se cylinder ki deewar par helix tak barabar lambai ki bohat si lakeerein, jo axis ke gird lagatar ghoomti hain. Isi radius ke surkh daire un ke siron ka rasta dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4 (b): Light ki circular polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.4 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Aik axis ke saath chalti circularly polarized roshni. Barabar lambai ke surkh electric field teer axis se bahar ki taraf lagatar badalte zaviyon par hain, aur un ke sire chalne ki simt ke gird lipte jamni helix par hain.
blocks.caption: Circular polarization (Figure 8.4b ke mutabiq asal 3D model; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Circular polarization mein electric field ki miqdar hamesha barabar rehti hai magar us ki simt har period mein aik chakkar ghoomti hai. Saamne se dekhein to E ka sira daire mein ghoomta hai; beam ke saath dekhein to helix banata hai.
labels: E keeps its size and turns
Tip of E traces a helix

fallback.text: Circular polarization: E ki miqdar barabar rehti hai aur woh lagatar ghoomta hai, is liye us ka sira beam ke saath helix banata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har lakeer ek lamhe ka E hai. Sab ki lambai barabar hai (miqdar nahi badalti) magar simt lehar ke aage barhne ke saath ghoomti jati hai, is liye siron se helix banta hai. Samne se dekhein to sira surkh daire par ghoomta hai: yahi circular polarization hai. Neeche 3D model ghuma kar dekhein.

Linear aur circular polarization ka mel, jis mein electric field vector elliptical rasta banata hai, elliptical polarization kehlata hai. Elliptical polarization (Fig. 8.4c) mein electric field ke do ajza E_x aur E_y barabar nahi hote, aur/ya un ke phase mein kisi bhi zawiye theta ka farq hota hai. Misal stress plate ya waveplate se guzarti light hai.

blocks.alt: x aur y axes ke milne ki jagah par markaz wala tirchha ellipse. Markaz se kaale teer E_x (x ke saath) aur E_y (y ke saath). Lambi axis par cyan lakeer a, chhoti axis par magenta lakeer b, aur y axis se lambi axis tak khamdaar teer theta.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4 (c): Light ki elliptical polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.4 (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: E ka sira daire ki bajaye ellipse par ghoomta hai kyunke E_x aur E_y barabar nahi aur/ya un ke phase mein farq hai. a aur b ellipse ki aadhi lambi aur aadhi chhoti axes hain. Figure mein theta y axis se ellipse ke jhukao (tilt) ka zawiya dikhata hai; text wala phase ka farq waqt ka farq hai, kaghaz par khincha zawiya nahi, magar ellipse ka jhukao isi phase farq aur E_x, E_y par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt: Plane polarized aur circularly polarized light ke kuch istemalat likhiye (constructed response 8.1).
blocks.explanation: Plane polarized light: chamak (glare) kam karne wale polarized sunglasses aur camera filters, LCD screens, polarization pakarne ke liye polarizer-analyzer intezam, optical activity se cheeni ke mehlool (solution) ka arhaaz (concentration) napna, aur materials ka stress analysis. Circular aur elliptical polarization tab paida hoti hai jab light CD ya DVD jaisi sathon se mun'akis ho ya stress plate ya waveplate se guzre, aur light ki polarization optical communication systems aur astronomy mein istemal hoti hai.

items: Linear: E ek satah mein (polarizing filter, sunglasses). Circular: E ghari ki simt (right-handed) ya ulti (left-handed) ghoomta hai (CD ya DVD reflection). Elliptical: E ellipse banata hai, E_x aur E_y na-barabar aur/ya theta se phase mein mukhtalif (stress plate, waveplate).
